page.overview:
Who is Carlos?

Carlos was the co-pilot of the plane in Jurassic World: Aftermath. The pilot was Juan.

Carlos' status is unknown, but it is likely that, he was fatally wounded in the crash caused, by a Pteranodon attack.

Carlos also had pushed Amelia Everett off the plane just, before the crash so that, she could parachute to safety.

Juan seemed to be speaking Spanish just, before they crashed, shouting instructions. After the crash, Juan had called for Carlos and got no reply, before calling for Sam, When Sam had explored the N.M.S Genetics Centre's Corporate section, he comes across Carlos's parachute near a Pteranodon nest.
